en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street scene in front of a one‑storey neoclassical building with the name "MEISENZAHL" on its façade. Several men stand with horses; two are mounted and one holds a horse by the bridle, suggesting a horse‑trading or export business. The printed title text above the image reads in German: "MEISENZAHL PFERDE-EXPORT FÜNFKIRCHEN – PÉCS. Telegr.-Adresse: Meisenzahl, Fünfkirchen." The reverse side is a blank divided back with the Hungarian heading "LEVELEZŐ-LAP" and a small imprint at the bottom right.
